units.source_text: 三年级第一学期，我旷课达六十多个小时，约为一年级三个学期总旷课时间的五倍。

en.t: In the first semester of my third year, I missed more than sixty hours of class, about five times the total number of hours I had missed over the three semesters of my first year.

units.source_text: 我旷课这么多时间，不是用来读书，也没有钱去娱乐，

en.t: I did not spend all that time away from class reading, and I had no money for amusements either,

units.source_text: 除了偶尔同拍本闲聊，就是我独自一人无所事事。

en.t: so apart from occasionally chatting idly with Kashiwagi, I simply stayed by myself doing nothing.

units.source_text: 大谷大学的记忆，同无为的记忆几乎是难以区分的。

en.t: My memories of Otani University were almost indistinguishable from memories of idleness.

units.source_text: 我缄口不言，独自一人无所作为。

en.t: I kept silent and, alone by myself, did nothing at all.

units.source_text: 或许这种无为也是我这号人的一种"样的教义一吧。

en.t: Perhaps this kind of idleness, too, was a sort of doctrine for a person like me.

units.source_text: 这种时候，我片刻也不感到寂寥。

en.t: At such times, I did not feel lonely for even a moment.
